blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Raffy Tulfo flagged on Friday around P71-million worth of government-procured medicines set to expire by March 2027. Tulfo expressed concern over expiring medicines during the deliberations on the Department of Health’s P274-billion budget for fiscal year 2027. “P11-million worth of HIV/AIDS medicine, P43 million for family planning medicine, and 15 million for nutrition again is about to expire at mababaon sa lupa before January next year,” Tulfo reported, citing an unnamed informant.
